category_fits.label: Technology & Innovation
category_fits.why_fit: The report is an outlook on technology and media, covering consumer technology, digital finance, cryptocurrency, NFTs, gaming and the metaverse, and enterprise software and automation across its forecast period.
category_fits.why_not_fit: It is a broad market and consumer outlook, not a focused report on infrastructure, product architecture, or one specific technology system.
evidence_sections: 14 Takeaways from the Activate Technology & Media Outlook 2022
Consumer Technology and Media Time and Attention
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly discusses infrastructure, enterprise technology, robotics, cybersecurity, hardware, or major technology shifts.
rule_evidence_sections: 14 Takeaways from the Activate Technology & Media Outlook 2022

Digital Consumer Finance at the Inflection Point

category_fits.label: Advertising Strategy & Media
category_fits.why_fit: The report forecasts global advertising revenue growth at 6.9% CAGR, faster than paid content and internet access.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Advertising is presented as a revenue segment in a broad technology and media outlook; the context does not show repeated coverage of media planning, buying, effectiveness, or advertising strategy.
evidence_sections: $390 Billion Global Technology and Media Growth Dollars Up for Grabs
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly covers media channels, ad receptivity, media planning, brand lift, investment priorities, or advertising strategy.
rule_evidence_sections: $390 Billion Global Technology and Media Growth Dollars Up for Grabs

category_fits.label: Consumer Behavior & Insights
category_fits.why_fit: Consumer time, attention, spending, and adoption behaviors are recurring themes, including forecasts of media use and findings about super users and cryptocurrency participation.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report also emphasizes market revenue forecasts across many technology and media sectors, so consumer behavior is a substantial lens rather than the sole organizing subject.
evidence_sections: Consumer Technology and Media Time and Attention
Super Users Will Drive the Digital Economy
Digital Consumer Finance at the Inflection Point

category_fits.label: Business Performance & Growth
category_fits.why_fit: The opening chapter forecasts $390 billion in global internet and media revenue growth from 2021E to 2025E and compares growth rates for advertising, paid content, and internet access; the report frames these trends as business opportunities.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report is a broad technology and media outlook, not primarily a guide to profitability, productivity, or performance levers for a particular business.
evidence_sections: $390 Billion Global Technology and Media Growth Dollars Up for Grabs
14 Takeaways from the Activate Technology & Media Outlook 2022

category_fits.label: Digital Payments & Wallets
category_fits.why_fit: The digital consumer finance chapter covers online-only payments, and the cryptocurrency chapter discusses potential payment and transfer uses.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Payments are one part of broader digital finance and cryptocurrency coverage; payment products, wallets, checkout, or payment security are not the report's dominant subject.
evidence_sections: Digital Consumer Finance at the Inflection Point
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly covers payments, wallets, fraud, checkout conversion, payment preferences, or transaction trust.
rule_evidence_sections: 14 Takeaways from the Activate Technology & Media Outlook 2022
Digital Consumer Finance at the Inflection Point

category_fits.label: Macroeconomics & Regional Outlooks
category_fits.why_fit: The report includes global and U.S. market forecasts extending through 2025E.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Its forecasts concern technology and media sectors and consumer behavior, not economy-wide indicators, policy, or broad regional economic conditions.
